description.en: 'the province in the southwest of the country: about two thirds up the coast to Haifa, and inland as far as Bayt Jibrīl' (Amitai 2017).
description.ar: 'the province in the southwest of the country: about two thirds up the coast to Haifa, and inland as far as Bayt Jibrīl' [الإقليم في جنوب غرب البلاد: نحو ثلثي الطريق صعودًا على الساحل إلى حيفا، وإلى الداخل حتى بيت جبريل] (عميتاي 2017).
description.he: “the province in the southwest of the country: about two thirds up the coast to Haifa, and inland as far as Bayt Jibrīl” [המחוז בדרום-מערב הארץ: כשני שלישים במעלה החוף עד חיפה, ובפנים הארץ עד בית ג׳יברין] (עמיתי 2017).

sources.quote: Gaza was the province in the southwest of the country: about two thirds up the coast to Haifa, and inland as far as Bayt Jibrīl.
according to al-Safadi: it included Jerusalem, Hebron, Nablus, Qāqūn, Ludd and Ramla.

notes.en: Temporary enlargement in the 1310s (Jerusalem, Hebron, Nablus) not mapped.
